text:
incident-bot: 📣 Paging maria (oncall) — realtime-streaming SLO breach detected: p99 generation latency 4.8s (SLO 1.5s) across eu-west model pool. Auto-escalation: severity=high, page sent to #incidents and on-call.

maria (oncall): On it. seeing a big spike in tail latency for streaming endpoints. anyone on call for quant/precision work?

kevin (sre): I can help with routing and capacity. Observability shows p95 ~ 900ms but p99 is exploding. Looks correlated with recent quant-profile rollout v3 -> int8 aggressive.

ajay (ml-runtime): We rolled updated quant-profile v3 ~10:02 UTC for a subset of models (int8 aggressive per-layer). Autocalibration was enabled during rollout. Rolling back in progress?

linda (prod-support): Having customers report partial streams cut out mid-response (they see long stalls). Opening customer-impact tracker.

maria (oncall): Key asks: 1) scope of rollout 2) quick mitigation (fallback to fp16 or previous profile) 3) ETA for recovery 4) customer comms draft.

tom (infra): Capacity is healthy, no infra-wide GPU throttles. Kernel scheduler traces show long kernel latencies on a small fraction of hosts (hot nodes). Might be a quant kernel path issue.

observability-bot: Related alerts: streaming-p99-surge EU cluster x3, kvcache-hit-fraction drop 0.12 -> 0.02, rpc-retries up 4x. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/5501234567

kevin (sre): I'm going to pin traffic off the affected pool and shift to fallback routing policy (route to dedicated pool eu-west-dedicated-1). Running command now:
```
redwood route adjust --from pool=int8-v3 --to pool=dedicated-eu-1 --percent=60
```

ajay (ml-runtime): Good. Meanwhile disabling autocalibration for v3 to stop live profile updates that may be amplifying instability.

ajay (ml-runtime): Command to disable autocalib:
```
redwood model update-profile --model sft-chat-13b --profile int8-v3 --autocalib=false
```

maria (oncall): Kevin/Tom, please monitor p99 during the routing change. Linda, start a minimal customer-facing note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls in EU, mitigation in progress." Keep it 1-line for now.

linda (prod-support): Drafted: "We’re aware of intermittent streaming stalls affecting a subset of EU requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we’ll update in ~30m or when we have a fix." Will post to affected customers after update.

kevin (sre): Routing change applied. Initial traffic shift shows p99 dropping from 4.8s -> 2.1s within 45s for routed traffic. But some hosts still show spikes.

tom (infra): Identified 3 hosts with elevated GPU kernel stalls correlated to int8 dequant path. Isolating them from the pool now.

observability-bot: Metric snapshots (eu-west): p95=0.98s, p99=2.4s (was 4.8s); stream-stalls/sec=0.65 (was 1.9). KVcache miss spike on int8-v3 nodes.

ajay (ml-runtime): Given stabilization but not full recovery, I'd recommend a controlled rollback of int8-v3 to int8-v2 (previous profile with safer per-layer thresholds). I'll prepare rollback patch.

maria (oncall): Approve rollback. Plan: 1) disable autocalib (done) 2) rollback profile on affected subset 3) keep routing to dedicated until p99 < 1.2s for 5m.

ajay (ml-runtime): Rolling back now to int8-v2 on the flagged model group. Command:
```
redwood model set-profile --model sft-chat-13b --profile int8-v2 --scope=eu-west-affected
```

ajay (ml-runtime): Rollback in flight. Progress: 40% -> 100% within 2m.

kevin (sre): After rollback p99 trending to 1.1s across the cluster. Streaming stalls have largely cleared on the previously impacted hosts.

maria (oncall): Good. Keep routing to dedicated for an extra 10 minutes to ensure tail stability, then gradually shift back.

linda (prod-support): Sending update to customers now with current status and expected next update in 30m.

linda (prod-support): Message sent. Affected customers acknowledged and asked for postmortem.

tom (infra): I've quarantined the 3 hot nodes and opened a ticket to repro kernel traces. Assigning to firmware/kernel team.

ajay (ml-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: aggressive int8 per-layer thresholds combined with autocalibration produced pathological numerical noise causing long dequant loops / kernel retries on certain activations, increasing per-token compute and causing KV cache thrash.

kevin (sre): Agreed. We'll mark as regression introduced by int8-v3 rollout. Need a mitigation playbook update: require staged perf tests under long contexts and disable autocalib by default for major profile changes.

maria (oncall): Creating post-incident ticket and assigning owners: ajay -> root cause + fix, tom -> node repro and kernel traces, kevin -> routing/ops playbook updates, linda -> customer comms and postmortem.

observability-bot: Created incident ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-5501234567

maria (oncall): Handing off to on-call shift change at 10:50 UTC. @kevin you'll own stabilization for the next hour. I'll take the postmortem lead.

kevin (sre): Ack. I'll keep the dedicated routing until metrics are stable and then run a canary to shift traffic back.

linda (prod-support): I'll prepare a short RCA draft focusing on quant-profile rollout safeguards and customer impact details.

ajay (ml-runtime): Follow-ups: 1) add unit/integration perf tests for autocalib changes 2) add canary gating for quant-profile rollouts 3) consider adding a fallback to fp16 for streaming workloads automatically if p99 > 2s.

maria (oncall): Thanks everyone — incident resolved to stable state. Will update primary incident thread with timeline and next steps. Closing page, but keep monitoring for the hour. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=stabilized, severity=high->mitigated, runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/quant-rollout-mitigation

kevin (sre): Quick note: we saw ~18 customer requests reflows with partial responses during the window; support will follow up.

linda (prod-support): Noted. We'll track follow-ups and post customer summary after RCAs.

maria (oncall): Hand-off complete. If anything reappears ping me directly."
